get.description: Retrieves discovered site links from Browserless.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The base URL to crawl for links.

schema.description: The base URL to crawl for links.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional query used to rank mapped links by relevance.

schema.description: Optional query used to rank mapped links by relevance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of links to return.

get.description: Retrieves web search results from Browserless.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The web search query to run.

schema.description: The web search query to run.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of search results to return.

schema.description: Optional maximum number of search results to return.

parameters.name: categories[]

schema.description: Optional category filters. Valid values are `github`, `pdf`, and `research`.

parameters.name: sources[]
parameters.description: Optional source filters. Valid values are `images`, `news`, and `web`.

get.description: Retrieves structured page data from a URL in Browserless.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL to scrape. Must be an http or https URL.

schema.description: The URL to scrape. Must be an http or https URL.

parameters.name: formats[]
parameters.description: Optional output formats to include in the smart scrape response.

schema.description: Optional output formats to include in the smart scrape response.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the smart scrape request.

schema.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the smart scrape request.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

attempted.description: Ordered list of Browserless strategies attempted for the request.

content.description: Captured page content returned by Browserless for the requested URL.

contentType.description: Content type reported for the captured content payload.

headers.description: Response headers observed by Browserless when fetching the target URL.

ok.description: Whether Browserless successfully completed the smart scrape request.

statusCode.description: HTTP-style status code returned by Browserless for the scrape result.

strategy.description: Browserless fetch strategy used to satisfy the smart scrape request.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Whether to return HTML content in the unblock response.

schema.description: Whether to return HTML content in the unblock response.

parameters.name: cookies

parameters.name: browserWSEndpoint
parameters.description: Whether to keep the browser alive and return a browserWSEndpoint for reconnects.
